src:
• Settings Hard Reset: Mess up some setting or keybinding? in this Home Main Menu,  Press & Hold 'Z+Q' on your Keyboard to reset.

• Re-spawn: Stuck or glitching thru the map? Press & Hold 'Z+R'. 

• War Scale: Increase amount of Player troop and enemy troop spawn quantity in Skirmish and Conquest.

• My Squad: Level up your troop and bring them to battle as your Squad. 
Troop will have permanent XP/Level and also permanent death (Buyback Required).
Only Toy Soldier has 'Second Chance Dying Perk'. 
Heal dying Toy Soldier to revive them.

• Item Shop: Every All unlocked item is permanent. Customize your Toy Hero and power up your gear.

• PvP & Toy-Box: Will not affect any of your save data progress and My Squad progress. Using too much light object (Lamp, Desk Lamp, ...) in Toy-Box will greatly reduce game performance.

• Lock object Toy-Box: Lock spawned object. Prevent Player accidentally remove object. 

• File Data: Accidentally delete a file/save data? go to 'Player_Data/Plastic Bin' folder to retreive back your data.

• STEAM® Leaderboard: Using Cheat Code during mission or Load Previous Save Game mission, that mission progress will not be submitted to the STEAM® Leaderboard.
zh:
• 强制重置设置：把设置或按键绑定弄乱了？在主菜单的基地界面按住键盘上的“Z+Q”即可重置。

• 重生：卡住或穿模掉出地图？按住“Z+R”。

• 战争规模：增加遭遇战和征服中玩家部队与敌方部队的生成数量。

• 我的小队：提升部队等级，带他们作为你的小队参战。
部队拥有永久的经验/等级，也会永久阵亡（需要花费赎回）。
只有玩具兵拥有“濒死二次机会”特性。
治疗濒死的玩具兵即可将其救回。

• 物品商店：所有已解锁的物品都是永久的。自定义你的玩具英雄并强化装备。

• PvP 与玩具箱：不会影响你的任何存档进度和我的小队进度。在玩具箱中使用过多发光物体（灯、台灯……）会大幅降低游戏性能。

• 玩具箱锁定物体：锁定已生成的物体，防止玩家误删。

• 文件数据：不小心删除了文件或存档？前往“Player_Data/Plastic Bin”文件夹找回你的数据。

• STEAM® 排行榜：在任务中使用作弊码或读取先前存档的任务时，该任务进度不会提交到 STEAM® 排行榜。
